task_name_raw: identifying semiconductors with ultralow lattice thermal conductivity
objective: efficiently discover semiconductors exhibiting ultralow lattice thermal conductivity (κL) for thermoelectric applications
input_requirements: descriptors derived from Magpie and Voronoi tessellations
output_goal: list of candidate semiconductors with ultralow κL

evidence.text: Here, we propose a novel hierarchy-boosted funnel learning (HiBoFL) framework, which is successfully applied to identify semiconductors with ultralow lattice thermal conductivity (κL).
We then apply this HiBoFL framework to efﬁciently identify semiconductors with ultralow κL as shown in Fig. 1b.

As a compelling demonstration, this framework has been successfully applied to identify semiconductors with ultralow κL, which circumvents large-scale brute-force ab initio calculations without clear objectives.

task_name_raw: fine-tuning pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials
objective: improve accuracy of a pretrained MLIP for a specific target system while preserving its generalizability and preventing catastrophic forgetting
material_scope: other sulfide, oxide, nitride, and halide electrolytes
output_goal: fine-tuned MLIP model with improved PES accuracy for LPSC and transferable knowledge to chemically distinct systems

evidence.text: Fine-tuning pretrained MLIPs offers a practical approach to improving accuracy for materials and properties where predictive performance is insufﬁcient.

Herein, we propose reEWC, an advanced ﬁne-tuning strategy that integrates Experience Replay and Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) to effectively balance forgetting prevention with ﬁne-tuning efﬁciency.
